description: This file contains functions for handling symbolic links and directory path checks, including caching mechanisms for filesystem stat calls, and functions for scheduling and removing directories, specifically related to symlink and directory path validation in a Git-related context.

methods.name: threaded_check_leading_path
methods.description: Checks if the leading component of a path is a symlink or directory.

methods.name: threaded_has_dirs_only_path
methods.description: Checks if all path components of a given path are directories.

methods.name: longest_path_match
methods.description: Finds the length of the longest common prefix of two paths.

methods.name: reset_lstat_cache
methods.description: Resets the cache used for filesystem stat calls.

methods.name: lstat_cache_matchlen
methods.description: Checks and caches the status of path components, including symlinks and directories.

methods.name: lstat_cache
methods.description: Wrapper for lstat_cache_matchlen to get flags for a path.

methods.name: threaded_has_symlink_leading_path
methods.description: Returns non-zero if the path has a leading symlink component.

methods.name: has_symlink_leading_path
methods.description: Checks if a path has a leading symlink component.

methods.name: check_leading_path
methods.description: Checks the leading path component for symlink or existence, with optional warning.

methods.name: threaded_check_leading_path
methods.description: Checks if the leading component of a path exists, is a directory, or has errors.

methods.name: has_dirs_only_path
methods.description: Checks if all path components are directories.

methods.name: schedule_dir_for_removal
methods.description: Schedules directories for removal, managing nested directory deletions.

methods.name: lstat_cache_aware_rmdir
methods.description: Removes a directory and invalidates cache if successful.
